parent_objective: create richer source-mining families after ordinary fresh/OOD mining failed to expose source-diverse outcome-sensitive rows
blocked_by: M983 pivots away from same-family mining to scenario-family generation
invalidates: claiming per-wheel or asymmetric fault coverage before dynamics support exists

public_gates: M984 must preserve P0 actor-input contract
M984 must keep hidden dynamics as simulator-only/logging-only fields
M984 must explicitly separate supported global-failure approximations from unsupported per-wheel failures
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters to actor inputs
do not claim split-mu or individual-wheel failure support without changing dynamics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_scenario_family: richer hidden-dynamics and emergency distributions for source-diverse proof mining
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: creates and smokes configs for extreme but currently supported scenario families before full mining
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure/config smoke only; no proof corpus, no training, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if any config cannot sample obstacle scenarios
stop if configs expose forbidden actor inputs
stop if the design depends on unsupported per-wheel dynamics
fallback_plan: if config smoke passes, route to multi-family source mining
if config smoke fails, narrow ranges until scenarios sample without changing actor inputs
if supported knobs are insufficient, design simulator fault extensions separately
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M983 opens extreme scenario-family generation after same-family surface refresh stalls

hypothesis: Existing single-track simulator knobs can define richer global-failure scenario families that are more likely to expose source-diverse wrong-history outcome sensitivity without violating the P0 actor contract.
success_criteria: each family samples valid obstacle scenarios
actor input contract remains P0 no-wheel/no-oracle
unsupported per-wheel failure scope is documented
failure_criteria: a config changes actor input contract
unsupported per-wheel fault claims are made
